questions.stem: The average age of \(25\) employees in a company is \(32\) years. If \(5\) new employees with an average age of \(28\) years join the company, what will be the new average age of all employees?
questions.keySolution:
Total age of \(25\) employees = \(25 \times 32 = 800\) years
Total age of \(5\) new employees = \(5 \times 28 = 140\) years
Total age of all \(30\) employees = \(800 + 140 = 940\) years
New average = \(\frac{940}{30} = 31.33\) years

questions.stem: A cricket team's average score in \(12\) matches is \(45\) runs. If they score \(60\) runs in their next match, what will be their new average?
questions.keySolution:
Total runs in \(12\) matches = \(12 \times 45 = 540\) runs
Total runs in \(13\) matches = \(540 + 60 = 600\) runs
New average = \(\frac{600}{13} = 46.15\) runs

questions.stem: The average weight of \(30\) students in a class is \(55\) kg. If the teacher whose weight is \(70\) kg joins them, what will be the average weight of all \(31\) persons?
questions.keySolution:
Total weight of \(30\) students = \(30 \times 55 = 1650\) kg
Total weight of \(31\) persons = \(1650 + 70 = 1720\) kg
New average = \(\frac{1720}{31} = 55.48\) kg

questions.stem: A factory produces \(120\) units per day on average over \(5\) days. On the sixth day, it produces \(150\) units. What is the new average daily production?
questions.keySolution:
Total production in \(5\) days = \(5 \times 120 = 600\) units
Total production in \(6\) days = \(600 + 150 = 750\) units
New average = \(\frac{750}{6} = 125\) units

questions.stem: The average salary of \(8\) employees is ₹\(25,000\). If one employee earning ₹\(30,000\) leaves and is replaced by another earning ₹\(20,000\), what is the new average salary?
A student's average marks in \(4\) subjects is \(75\). To achieve an overall average of \(80\) in \(5\) subjects, what marks should he score in the fifth subject?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks in \(4\) subjects = \(4 \times 75 = 300\)
Required total for \(5\) subjects = \(5 \times 80 = 400\)
Marks needed in fifth subject = \(400 - 300 = 100\) marks

questions.stem: The average temperature of a city for \(6\) days was \(28°C\). If the temperature on the seventh day was \(35°C\), what is the average temperature for all \(7\) days?
questions.keySolution:
Total temperature for \(6\) days = \(6 \times 28 = 168°C\)
Total temperature for \(7\) days = \(168 + 35 = 203°C\)
New average = \(\frac{203}{7} = 29°C\)

questions.stem: A car travels at an average speed of \(60\) km/h for the first \(3\) hours and \(80\) km/h for the next \(2\) hours. What is the average speed for the entire journey?
questions.keySolution:
Distance in first \(3\) hours = \(3 \times 60 = 180\) km
Distance in next \(2\) hours = \(2 \times 80 = 160\) km
Total distance = \(180 + 160 = 340\) km
Total time = \(3 + 2 = 5\) hours
Average speed = \(\frac{340}{5} = 68\) km/h

questions.stem: The average height of \(15\) players in a basketball team is \(6.2\) feet. If \(3\) players with an average height of \(6.8\) feet join the team, what will be the new average height?
questions.keySolution:
Total height of \(15\) players = \(15 \times 6.2 = 93\) feet
Total height of \(3\) new players = \(3 \times 6.8 = 20.4\) feet
Total height of \(18\) players = \(93 + 20.4 = 113.4\) feet
New average = \(\frac{113.4}{18} = 6.3\) feet

questions.stem: A company's average monthly profit for \(8\) months is ₹\(2,50,000\). If the profit in the ninth month is ₹\(3,50,000\), what is the new average monthly profit?
The average price of \(10\) items is ₹\(45\). If two items costing ₹\(60\) each are added, what will be the new average price?
questions.keySolution:
Total cost of \(10\) items = \(10 \times 45 = ₹450\)
Total cost of \(12\) items = \(450 + 2 \times 60 = ₹570\)
New average = \(\frac{570}{12} = ₹47.5\)

questions.stem: A batsman has an average of \(42\) runs after \(15\) innings. How many runs should he score in his \(16^{th}\) innings to raise his average to \(44\)?
questions.keySolution:
Total runs in \(15\) innings = \(15 \times 42 = 630\) runs
Required total for \(16\) innings = \(16 \times 44 = 704\) runs
Runs needed in \(16^{th}\) innings = \(704 - 630 = 74\) runs

questions.stem: The average attendance in a school for \(5\) days is \(240\) students. If \(20\) more students join from the sixth day onward and the attendance becomes \(260\), what is the new average for \(6\) days?
questions.keySolution:
Total attendance for \(5\) days = \(5 \times 240 = 1200\) students
Attendance on \(6^{th}\) day = \(260\) students
Total attendance for \(6\) days = \(1200 + 260 = 1460\) students
New average = \(\frac{1460}{6} = 243.33\) students

questions.stem: A family of \(6\) members has an average income of ₹\(15,000\) per month. If two earning members leave the family, and the remaining \(4\) members have a combined income of ₹\(40,000\), what was the average income of the two members who left?
questions.keySolution:
Total income of \(6\) members = \(6 \times 15,000 = ₹90,000\)
Total income of \(4\) remaining members = ₹\(40,000\)
Total income of \(2\) members who left = \(90,000 - 40,000 = ₹50,000\)
Average income of \(2\) members who left = \(\frac{50,000}{2} = ₹25,000\)

questions.stem: The average age of a group of \(20\) people is \(35\) years. If \(5\) people with an average age of \(25\) years leave the group, what is the new average age?
questions.keySolution:
Total age of \(20\) people = \(20 \times 35 = 700\) years
Total age of \(5\) people who left = \(5 \times 25 = 125\) years
Total age of remaining \(15\) people = \(700 - 125 = 575\) years
New average = \(\frac{575}{15} = 38.33\) years

questions.stem: A shop owner sells \(40\) items at an average price of ₹\(250\) each. If he wants to maintain the same total revenue by selling only \(32\) items, what should be the new average price per item?
questions.keySolution:
Total revenue from \(40\) items = \(40 \times 250 = ₹10,000\)
For \(32\) items to generate same revenue:
New average price = \(\frac{10,000}{32} = ₹312.5\)

questions.stem: The average score of \(12\) students in a test is \(68\). If the scores of \(3\) students (\(72, 75, 81\)) are excluded, what is the average score of the remaining \(9\) students?
questions.keySolution:
Total score of \(12\) students = \(12 \times 68 = 816\)
Total score of \(3\) excluded students = \(72 + 75 + 81 = 228\)
Total score of remaining \(9\) students = \(816 - 228 = 588\)
Average of remaining students = \(\frac{588}{9} = 65.33\)

questions.stem: A train travels \(300\) km in \(5\) hours and then \(400\) km in \(4\) hours. What is the average speed for the entire journey?
questions.keySolution:
Total distance = \(300 + 400 = 700\) km
Total time = \(5 + 4 = 9\) hours
Average speed = \(\frac{700}{9} = 77.78\) km/h

questions.stem: The average rainfall in a city for \(7\) days is \(15\) mm. If it rains \(25\) mm on the eighth day, what is the new average rainfall?
questions.keySolution:
Total rainfall for \(7\) days = \(7 \times 15 = 105\) mm
Total rainfall for \(8\) days = \(105 + 25 = 130\) mm
New average = \(\frac{130}{8} = 16.25\) mm

questions.stem: A bowler takes \(20\) wickets in \(5\) matches with an average of \(4\) wickets per match. If he takes \(6\) wickets in the next match, what is his new average?
questions.keySolution:
Total wickets in \(5\) matches = \(5 \times 4 = 20\) wickets
Total wickets in \(6\) matches = \(20 + 6 = 26\) wickets
New average = \(\frac{26}{6} = 4.33\) wickets

questions.stem: The average expenditure of a household for \(6\) months is ₹\(35,000\). If the expenditure in the seventh month is ₹\(42,000\), what is the new average monthly expenditure?
questions.keySolution:
Total expenditure for \(6\) months = \(6 \times 35,000 = ₹2,10,000\)
Total expenditure for \(7\) months = \(2,10,000 + 42,000 = ₹2,52,000\)
New average = \(\frac{2,52,000}{7} = ₹36,000\)

questions.stem: A worker's average daily wage for \(8\) days is ₹\(800\). If his wage on the ninth day is ₹\(1,000\), what is his new average daily wage?
questions.keySolution:
Total wage for \(8\) days = \(8 \times 800 = ₹6,400\)
Total wage for \(9\) days = \(6,400 + 1,000 = ₹7,400\)
New average = \(\frac{7,400}{9} = ₹822.22\)

questions.stem: The average marks of \(25\) students in a class is \(72\). If \(5\) students with an average of \(80\) marks leave the class, what is the new average of the remaining students?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of \(25\) students = \(25 \times 72 = 1800\)
Total marks of \(5\) students who left = \(5 \times 80 = 400\)
Total marks of remaining \(20\) students = \(1800 - 400 = 1400\)
New average = \(\frac{1400}{20} = 70\) marks

questions.stem: A company's average quarterly sales for \(4\) quarters is ₹\(8\) lakhs. If the sales in the first quarter was ₹\(6\) lakhs and in the second quarter was ₹\(9\) lakhs, and the third quarter was ₹\(7\) lakhs, what was the sales in the fourth quarter?
questions.keySolution:
Total sales for \(4\) quarters = \(4 \times 8 = ₹32\) lakhs
Sales in first three quarters = \(6 + 9 + 7 = ₹22\) lakhs
Sales in fourth quarter = \(32 - 22 = ₹10\) lakhs

questions.stem: A cyclist covers \(120\) km in \(4\) hours and then \(90\) km in \(3\) hours. What is his average speed for the entire journey?
questions.keySolution:
Total distance = \(120 + 90 = 210\) km
Total time = \(4 + 3 = 7\) hours
Average speed = \(\frac{210}{7} = 30\) km/h

questions.stem: The average production of a factory for \(10\) days is \(500\) units per day. Due to a machine breakdown, production for \(2\) days was only \(200\) units per day. What should be the average daily production for the remaining \(8\) days to maintain the overall average?
questions.keySolution:
Target total production for \(10\) days = \(10 \times 500 = 5000\) units
Actual production for \(2\) days = \(2 \times 200 = 400\) units
Required production for remaining \(8\) days = \(5000 - 400 = 4600\) units
Required average for \(8\) days = \(\frac{4600}{8} = 575\) units

questions.stem: The average age of \(10\) members of a family is \(30\) years. If the age of the youngest member is \(10\) years, what is the average age of the remaining \(9\) members?
questions.keySolution:
Total age of \(10\) members = \(10 \times 30 = 300\) years
Total age of remaining \(9\) members = \(300 - 10 = 290\) years
Average age of remaining \(9\) members = \(\frac{290}{9} = 32.22\) years

questions.stem: A shopkeeper sells \(20\) items at ₹\(50\) each and \(30\) items at ₹\(70\) each. What is the average selling price per item?
questions.keySolution:
Total revenue = \(20 \times 50 + 30 \times 70 = 1000 + 2100 = ₹3100\)
Total items = \(20 + 30 = 50\)
Average selling price = \(\frac{3100}{50} = ₹62\)

questions.stem: The average consumption of fuel by a vehicle for \(6\) days is \(25\) liters per day. If the consumption on the seventh day is \(32\) liters, what is the new average daily consumption?
questions.keySolution:
Total consumption for \(6\) days = \(6 \times 25 = 150\) liters
Total consumption for \(7\) days = \(150 + 32 = 182\) liters
New average = \(\frac{182}{7} = 26\) liters

questions.stem: A student scores \(85, 90, 78, 92\) in four tests. What should he score in the fifth test to have an average of \(88\) across all five tests?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of first four test scores = \(85 + 90 + 78 + 92 = 345\)
Required total for \(5\) tests = \(5 \times 88 = 440\)
Score needed in fifth test = \(440 - 345 = 95\)

questions.stem: The average weight of \(12\) boxes is \(45\) kg. If \(3\) boxes weighing \(50\) kg each are removed, what is the new average weight?
questions.keySolution:
Total weight of \(12\) boxes = \(12 \times 45 = 540\) kg
Weight of \(3\) boxes removed = \(3 \times 50 = 150\) kg
Weight of remaining \(9\) boxes = \(540 - 150 = 390\) kg
New average = \(\frac{390}{9} = 43.33\) kg

questions.stem: A cricket team scores \(250, 300, 200, 280\) runs in four matches. What should they score in the fifth match to have an average of \(260\) runs per match?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of runs in four matches = \(250 + 300 + 200 + 280 = 1030\) runs
Required total for \(5\) matches = \(5 \times 260 = 1300\) runs
Runs needed in fifth match = \(1300 - 1030 = 270\) runs

questions.stem: The average price of \(8\) books is ₹\(120\). If \(2\) books costing ₹\(150\) each are added to the collection, what is the new average price?
questions.keySolution:
Total cost of \(8\) books = \(8 \times 120 = ₹960\)
Total cost of \(10\) books = \(960 + 2 \times 150 = ₹1260\)
New average = \(\frac{1260}{10} = ₹126\)

questions.stem: A runner completes \(5\) km in \(25\) minutes and \(3\) km in \(18\) minutes. What is his average speed in km/h for the entire run?
questions.keySolution:
Total distance = \(5 + 3 = 8\) km
Total time = \(25 + 18 = 43\) minutes = \(\frac{43}{60}\) hours
Average speed = \(\frac{8}{43/60} = \frac{8 \times 60}{43} = 11.16\) km/h

questions.stem: The average electricity bill of a household for \(9\) months is ₹\(1,500\). If the bill for the tenth month is ₹\(2,000\), what is the new average monthly bill?
questions.keySolution:
Total bill for \(9\) months = \(9 \times 1500 = ₹13,500\)
Total bill for \(10\) months = \(13,500 + 2,000 = ₹15,500\)
New average = \(\frac{15,500}{10} = ₹1,550\)

questions.stem: A factory produces \(200\) units on Monday, \(250\) units on Tuesday, and \(180\) units on Wednesday. What should be the production on Thursday to have an average of \(220\) units per day over four days?
questions.keySolution:
Production in first three days = \(200 + 250 + 180 = 630\) units
Required total for \(4\) days = \(4 \times 220 = 880\) units
Production needed on Thursday = \(880 - 630 = 250\) units

questions.stem: The average marks of \(30\) students is \(65\). If the marks of the topper (\(95\)) and the lowest scorer (\(35\)) are excluded, what is the average marks of the remaining \(28\) students?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of \(30\) students = \(30 \times 65 = 1950\)
Marks of excluded students = \(95 + 35 = 130\)
Total marks of remaining \(28\) students = \(1950 - 130 = 1820\)
Average of remaining students = \(\frac{1820}{28} = 65\)

questions.stem: A delivery service completes \(40\) deliveries on average per day for \(5\) days. On the sixth day, they complete \(50\) deliveries. What is the new average?
questions.keySolution:
Total deliveries in \(5\) days = \(5 \times 40 = 200\)
Total deliveries in \(6\) days = \(200 + 50 = 250\)
New average = \(\frac{250}{6} = 41.67\) deliveries

questions.stem: A restaurant serves an average of \(150\) customers per day for \(6\) days. On the seventh day, they serve \(200\) customers. What is the new average?
questions.keySolution:
Total customers in \(6\) days = \(6 \times 150 = 900\)
Total customers in \(7\) days = \(900 + 200 = 1100\)
New average = \(\frac{1100}{7} = 157.14\) customers

questions.stem: The average income of \(15\) people is ₹\(25,000\). If \(3\) people with an average income of ₹\(35,000\) join the group, what is the new average income?
questions.keySolution:
Total income of \(15\) people = \(15 \times 25,000 = ₹3,75,000\)
Total income of \(3\) new people = \(3 \times 35,000 = ₹1,05,000\)
Total income of \(18\) people = \(3,75,000 + 1,05,000 = ₹4,80,000\)
New average = \(\frac{4,80,000}{18} = ₹26,667\)

questions.stem: A cab driver earns ₹\(800, ₹950, ₹750, ₹1100\) on four consecutive days. How much should he earn on the fifth day to have an average of ₹\(900\) per day?
questions.keySolution:
Earnings in first four days = \(800 + 950 + 750 + 1100 = ₹3600\)
Required total for \(5\) days = \(5 \times 900 = ₹4500\)
Earnings needed on fifth day = \(4500 - 3600 = ₹900\)

questions.stem: The average test score of \(20\) students is \(75\). If \(5\) students who scored an average of \(65\) are excluded from the calculation, what is the average score of the remaining \(15\) students?
questions.keySolution:
Total marks of \(20\) students = \(20 \times 75 = 1500\)
Total marks of \(5\) excluded students = \(5 \times 65 = 325\)
Total marks of remaining \(15\) students = \(1500 - 325 = 1175\)
Average of remaining students = \(\frac{1175}{15} = 78.33\)

questions.stem: A swimming pool is filled at an average rate of \(500\) liters per hour for \(8\) hours. If the rate in the ninth hour is \(600\) liters, what is the new average filling rate?
questions.keySolution:
Total water filled in \(8\) hours = \(8 \times 500 = 4000\) liters
Total water filled in \(9\) hours = \(4000 + 600 = 4600\) liters
New average rate = \(\frac{4600}{9} = 511.11\) liters/hour

questions.stem: The average speed of a bus for \(6\) hours is \(45\) km/h. If it travels at \(60\) km/h for the next \(2\) hours, what is the average speed for the entire \(8\)-hour journey?
questions.keySolution:
Distance in first \(6\) hours = \(6 \times 45 = 270\) km
Distance in next \(2\) hours = \(2 \times 60 = 120\) km
Total distance = \(270 + 120 = 390\) km
Total time = \(6 + 2 = 8\) hours
Average speed = \(\frac{390}{8} = 48.75\) km/h

questions.stem: A shopkeeper's average daily sales for \(12\) days is ₹\(8,000\). If his sales on the \(13^{th}\) day is ₹\(11,000\), what is his new average daily sales?
The average expenditure of a person for \(7\) days is ₹\(300\) per day. If his expenditure on the eighth day is ₹\(500\), what is his average daily expenditure for \(8\) days?
questions.keySolution:
Total expenditure for \(7\) days = \(7 \times 300 = ₹2,100\)
Total expenditure for \(8\) days = \(2,100 + 500 = ₹2,600\)
New average = \(\frac{2,600}{8} = ₹325\)

questions.stem: A library receives an average of \(80\) visitors per day for \(5\) days. On the weekend (\(2\) days), it receives \(120\) visitors per day. What is the average number of visitors per day for the entire week?
questions.keySolution:
Visitors in \(5\) weekdays = \(5 \times 80 = 400\)
Visitors in \(2\) weekend days = \(2 \times 120 = 240\)
Total visitors in \(7\) days = \(400 + 240 = 640\)
Average per day = \(\frac{640}{7} = 91.43\) visitors

questions.stem: A machine produces \(300\) items per hour on average for \(4\) hours. In the fifth hour, it produces \(450\) items. What is the new average production rate?
questions.keySolution:
Total production in \(4\) hours = \(4 \times 300 = 1200\) items
Total production in \(5\) hours = \(1200 + 450 = 1650\) items
New average = \(\frac{1650}{5} = 330\) items/hour
